name: OEM_EN.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Source Product
Requirement 1
Change the front mask
The letter format(eg.change to Calibri), now is Ariel format
The letter content(eg. FX1 to SFP 1)
eg. 100/1000Mbps Industrial Fiber Switch to Unmanaged 1G Industrial Switch(see above photo)
eg. 100/1000Mbps Industrial Fiber Switch to 100/1000Mbps POE Media Converter
The letter position(eg. Left/Center)
The letter color(eg. white to red)
The bar color(eg. blue to black)
The whole housing(color/holes...)
Requirement 2
Print customer logo
Generally, it would be placed on the middle of the upper panel.
Requirement 3
Change the mounting method
Din rail is the original version
Have an earring
Change to below version
This is the spring din rail bracket, pull down to have the device fixed in the din-rail bracket.
Compared to the original fixed din rail bracket, it is more flexible and easy to operate.
Change to ‘L’ shape for actual needs
Managed Switch
It is fine to change the UI content(add model name, change the title...)/color(gray/blue...).
We usually put customer logo on the top left, it is OK.
For more complex changes, please let us know.
